name: sts
description: Security Token Service Security Token Service (STS) enables you to request temporary, limited-privilege credentials for users.

subcommands.name: assume-role
subcommands.description: Returns a set of temporary security credentials that you can use to access Amazon Web Services resources.

options.name: --role-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to assume

options.name: --role-session-name
options.description: An identifier for the assumed role session.

options.name: --policy-arns
options.description: The Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the IAM managed policies that you want to use as managed session policies.

options.name: --policy
options.description: An IAM policy in JSON format that you want to use as an inline session policy. This parameter is optional.

options.name: --duration-seconds
options.description: The duration, in seconds, of the role session. The value specified can range from 900 seconds (15 minutes) up to the maximum session duration set for the role.

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of session tags that you want to pass. Each session tag consists of a key name and an associated value.

options.name: --transitive-tag-keys
options.description: A list of keys for session tags that you want to set as transitive.

options.name: --external-id
options.description: A unique identifier that might be required when you assume a role in another account.

options.name: --serial-number
options.description: The identification number of the MFA device that is associated with the user who is making the AssumeRole call.

options.name: --token-code
options.description: The value provided by the MFA device, if the trust policy of the role being assumed requires MFA.

options.name: --source-identity
options.description: The source identity specified by the principal that is calling the AssumeRole operation. The source identity value persists across chained role sessions.

options.name: --provided-contexts
options.description: A list of previously acquired trusted context assertions in the format of a JSON array.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.description: Returns a set of temporary security credentials (consisting of an access key ID, a secret access key, and a security token) for a user.

options.description: The name of the federated user. The name is used as an identifier for the temporary security credentials (such as Bob).
